requests.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a clear animation CHARACTER TURNAROUND for a quiet autumn-travel fan derivative starring the DeepSeek whale girl, the community blue whale-maid.
Input images: Image1 is the directly viewed ZipZipPipe whale-maid design, for character identity, garments and colors. Image2 is a widely circulated chibi whale-maid, for recognizable shared identity only; ignore all writing, emoji, hearts and pose. These are supporting references for a newly composed design sheet.
Primary request: Show the SAME illustrated feminine whale girl in three coherent full-body views: front, left three-quarter side, and back. Each is the same character, outfit and proportions. Standard anime proportions around six heads tall. All three complete bodies, shoes, head accessories, hair and tail must fit with generous clean spacing. One calm friendly closed-mouth expression; visible eyes fully OPEN. The back view shows only the back.
Identity: deep indigo-blue crown and fringe, long flowing blue hair fading to sea-blue lighter ends; curved single ahoge; large blue/cyan eyes; two smooth cetacean head fins extending sideways from the hair, not furry cat ears; white frilled maid headband with small sky-blue ribbon; navy feminine long-sleeved dress with white frilled collar and cuffs, blue neck bow, pale blue central skirt panel and restrained thin gold wave trim at the lower hem; white lace-edged apron with one small blue whale pictogram; light stockings and navy rounded Mary Jane shoes. Match the references recognizably. Hair reaches below the waist. A single substantial blue WHALE tail attaches naturally behind the lower back, ending in a broad bilateral horizontal two-fluke shape; the tail is not an arm and does not replace her two human legs.
Style: polished 2D anime concept illustration, precise readable contours, restrained soft cel shading, consistent garment construction. Feminine, charming, fully clothed, suitable for travel merchandise. Avoid photoreal skin or fashion portrait rendering.
Composition: wide landscape three-view reference sheet on plain warm off-white, even neutral studio-like illustration light. Absolutely NO text, labels, measurements, logos, watermarks, speech bubbles or background scene. No invented extra costume, no glasses, no alternate hairstyle, no exaggerated expression. Do not reproduce either reference composition.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single clean CHIBI CHARACTER MASTER, with genuine transparent background, for the DeepSeek whale-girl autumn-travel merchandise.
Input images: Image1 is our newly made standard-proportion turnaround, the exact master for this project's blue hair, blue eyes, head fins, whale tail and navy/white/gold maid outfit. Image2 is the original ZipZipPipe character design, reinforcing identity. Image3 is the familiar round-faced community whale girl, used for the compact proportions and recognizable charm only; discard all meme lettering, hearts and gestures.
Primary request: Draw ONE full-body round-cheeked whale girl in a charming 2.3-head chibi proportion. Very large round head, small soft body, short arms and legs. Front-facing with a slight three-quarter turn only sufficient to make one whale tail clearly visible beside her; relaxed hands at her sides, closed-mouth soft cheerful smile. Both large blue eyes fully OPEN. She must read instantly as the blue whale maid from the references.
Identity lock: long navy-to-sea-blue gradient hair and one curved ahoge, smooth side head fins, white frilled maid headband with blue side ribbon, navy dress and long sleeves, white collar and frilled cuffs, neck bow with blue center, white lace-edged apron with one little blue whale pictogram, muted fine gold wave trim, light stockings, rounded navy shoes. ONE thick blue whale tail with horizontal bilateral flukes behind her lower back; two ordinary human arms and two legs, not a mermaid. Tail should be chunky and rounded as a memorable small-merch silhouette. Preserve the references' feminine whale-maid identity. No glasses, no wings, no costume variations.
Style: crisp polished 2D anime merchandise art, clean contours, restrained soft shading; face and white apron retain detail with no blown-out highlights. Cute round cheeks, no angry, crying or seductive expression.
Composition: one isolated full-body character, centered with safe transparent margin around every hair tip, tail, shoe and ahoge. Genuine transparent alpha, no floor, no shadow plane, no checkerboard painted into pixels, no labels, text, logos, border, extra props, speech bubbles or extra figures. This is flat illustration, not a plush render.

Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: photorealistic concept of ONE manufacturable sewn collectible plush, for a quiet autumn-travel film.
Input images: Image1 is the exact chibi character design to translate into fabric; Image2 reinforces costume colors and whale anatomy. They are identity references, not editing targets.
Subject: One roughly20cm seated round-headed whale-maid plush, shown whole in a gentle front three-quarter product view, including its two short soft arms, two navy shoes, white apron and the single chunky blue tail peeking around the side. Match the chibi head shape, OPEN blue eye embroidery, curved ahoge, head fins and costume. Translate flowing blue hair into a few soft layered felt or short-pile fabric panels with neat visible seams and lighter sea-blue tips. Construct the white frilled headband, apron and navy dress from convincing small-scale cotton, felt and velour, with embroidered fine gold details and a small embroidered blue whale on the apron. The two fin ears and tail are stuffed fabric pieces; tail flukes are thick and rounded.
Style: believable natural-light product photograph, not a living girl or smooth plastic figurine. Slightly imperfect fabric, restrained embroidery and tactile pile are desirable. Soft overcast window daylight and scene-matched low-contrast shadows. Face and white apron remain softly shaded with real textile detail, never luminous or overexposed.
Composition: one plush sitting securely on a simple warm off-white tabletop, neutral pale gray-beige background, medium close view, whole silhouette and tail inside the image with comfortable margin. No extra accessories or panels.
Constraints: Every depiction is the SAME DeepSeek fan whale-maid as the supplied project masters: navy-to-light-sea-blue flowing long hair, a single curved ahoge, smooth side head fins, wide OPEN blue eyes, white frilled maid headband with side blue ribbon, navy/white feminine maid dress and lace-edged white apron with a little blue whale pictogram, fine muted gold hem accents, and one broad blue whale tail. No glasses. No closed eyes or alternate identity. All faces are printed, illustrated or embroidered fictional character art only. No real people, hands, body parts, extra characters, speech, packaging claims, price tags, text, watermark, brand wordmarks or decorative slogans.

Asset type: a realistic tabletop CONCEPT PHOTO of three related travel-merch formats.
Input images: Image1 is the exact standard-proportion character master for the acrylic standee. Image2 is the exact chibi artwork for die-cut stickers and the round pin badge.

LEFT: one clear3mm acrylic standee, approximately16cm high, printing the complete front-view standard-proportion navy whale-maid from Image1, including ahoge, head fins, dress, both shoes and tail, with a crisp transparent contour margin and a physically plausible transparent oval base. CENTER: three separated matte die-cut character stickers using the Image2 identity; one full-body standing, one calm seated, one little head portrait; every visible eye OPEN. RIGHT: one58mm round metal pin badge printed with the same Q-version blue-haired OPEN-eyed portrait; a narrow real metal rim and restrained reflections. Product scale and all edges must be believable, artwork must follow each material surface.
Make the illustrations crisp and consistent without warping their eyes, head fins or glasses-free face. All printed surfaces inherit ambient shade; white cheeks and aprons do not glow. Use broad diffused daylight, modest real material textures and no glossy beauty-ad lighting.
Show all products uncropped, with enough space to inspect each. No package, card labels, dimensions, title, text or hands.
Constraints: Every depiction is the SAME DeepSeek fan whale-maid as the supplied project masters: navy-to-light-sea-blue flowing long hair, a single curved ahoge, smooth side head fins, wide OPEN blue eyes, white frilled maid headband with side blue ribbon, navy/white feminine maid dress and lace-edged white apron with a little blue whale pictogram, fine muted gold hem accents, and one broad blue whale tail. No glasses. No closed eyes or alternate identity. All faces are printed, illustrated or embroidered fictional character art only. Input images: Image1 is the exact chibi master for ALL surface artwork. Image2 reinforces standard colors and costume details; do not switch identities.
Three objects only, naturally arranged on an ordinary pale wooden bench against a neutral softly lit background. One unbleached cotton-canvas shoulder tote with dark-navy handles, visible weave, real stitched seams and a full-body chibi whale-maid screen print centered on its front. One simple cream glazed ceramic mug beside it, handle clearly attached and usable, printed with the same chibi character and a tiny blue whale motif. One small die-cut clear acrylic chibi keychain with an attached real silver split ring and short navy woven loop, placed in front with a visible transparent edge. The character's blue OPEN eyes and navy-to-blue hair must remain recognizable and undistorted on all three surfaces, with the single tail visible in the full-body prints. Printing follows canvas folds and mug curvature, not stickers floating above surfaces. Keep the face and apron in the same soft natural shade as the material around them. Preserve modest cream/blue colors, use marks and ordinary daylight; no dramatic glare or unreal bright face patches.
Whole objects visible, balanced horizontal medium product photo, enough separation to see each design. No humans, food, plants, unrelated decor, package, captions or lettering.
Constraints: Every depiction is the SAME DeepSeek fan whale-maid as the supplied project masters: navy-to-light-sea-blue flowing long hair, a single curved ahoge, smooth side head fins, wide OPEN blue eyes, white frilled maid headband with side blue ribbon, navy/white feminine maid dress and lace-edged white apron with a little blue whale pictogram, fine muted gold hem accents, and one broad blue whale tail. No glasses. No closed eyes or alternate identity. All faces are printed, illustrated or embroidered fictional character art only. No real people, hands, body parts, extra characters, speech, packaging claims, price tags, text, watermark, brand wordmarks or decorative slogans.

Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: one landscape scene concept / first-frame visual test for a1344x768 silent autumn travel derivative film.
Input images: Image1 is the EXACT fabric whale-maid plush product design to place physically into the scene; preserve its sewn blue-gradient hair, curved ahoge, white frilled headband, blue ribbon, blue OPEN embroidered eyes, side fins, navy/white/gold maid dress, apron with tiny whale embroidery, two small seated feet, and thick blue whale tail. Image2 is the matching flat chibi artwork for ONE round pin on the backpack. Do not turn this into a living girl or a real person's face.
Scene: a believable ordinary alpine lakeside in late autumn. Weathered gray-brown rock in the foreground, modest gray-blue rippling water, uneven ochre grasses and brown weathered slopes with only sparse residual snow, broken overcast clouds. A small seated20cm whale-maid plush rests securely on the foreground rock beside a worn charcoal-black fabric hiking daypack, with realistic straps, zipper, seams and a single small round metal pin printing the Image2 blue-haired character on the pack. Plush and bag occupy roughly the lower-right third; an expansive readable lake and real mountain geography fill the remaining frame.
Light and material: photograph-like natural overcast daylight, restrained saturation, modest atmospheric distance, tactile short-pile plush, embroidery, canvas wear and mineral rock grain. The plush face and white apron are softly shaded under the SAME cloud light, with contact shadows at its feet and base. They must never look independently lit, luminous or pasted-on. No unreal perfect turquoise water, no magical sunrise, no fantasy scenery.
Composition: wide7:4 landscape, target1344x768, eye-level medium-wide natural travel photograph. Complete plush, tail and backpack visible with safe margins. A calm freely traveling feeling, credible scale, no theatrical studio lighting. No title or other text anywhere. No person, hand, limb, reflection, passerby or unrelated character. Only the existing fictional embroidered and printed character faces. Unobstructed foreground rock, open shoreline, no foreground tree or branch, no free-flying butterfly. One coherent photograph, not panels or a collage.
